svg.title: The 20 file tasks: plain loop, deep agent, and deep agent on the disk
svg.desc: A grid of the 20 file tasks for three models and three harnesses. A filled square is a pass, a rose square a fail. A green dot under a square marks a run where the model wrote with a Deep Agents file tool, and a grey dot a run where it only read with one. With the default backend those tools write to the agent state, and the checker reads the disk. Qwen3 4B passed 16 plain, 2 as a default deep agent, and 16 with FilesystemBackend. Qwen3 8B passed 17, 5 and 9. Claude Haiku 5.5 passed 20, 20 and 19.
svg.text: wrote with write_file, edit_file, or delete
default: StateBackend, files live in the agent state. on disk: FilesystemBackend on the task folder.
Every row also had the five task tools that write the folder. The checker reads the folder.
